cinematicDiagnostic.scope: Informative Navara-only cinematic, one measured context after discarded warm-up; no performance ratio or gate claim. This exercises the model display pass absent from minimal.

geometryFollowup.scope: Fixed fixture/app clock only for geometry; real-time fresh layer restored for input/follow/voice. Five visible controls per pose. Follow minimum range measured against public settled cache; older query/focus ranges retained. No threshold relaxation. All 8 common W1 suites and8 comparisons invalidated for fresh repeat. Prior failed/invalidated rows are preserved in acceptance-runs; accepted-steps is derived current summary.

shareRuntimeFollowup.scope: All24 engine/mode layer runs repeated with primary and every share page observed; exact preview setup404 only; no app/build/measurement changes. Prior weak observer rows explicitly invalidated in preserved ledger.

httpDiagnosticsFollowup.scope: Only browser error-location/HTTP-status evidence added; no criteria or app/build changes. Existing measurement contexts remain valid.

finalConsoleFollowup.scope: Final console/runtime checks after browser teardown, late-error/failed-check comparison rejection, scoped Native INFO probe, explicit idle settling. All12 W1 suites and12 comparisons invalidated for fresh repeat. No app/build changes; all five measurements and gesture proof remain valid.

previewMilitaryHttp500History.scope: Initial final16 attempt failed: Cesium24/25 due one resource HTTP500, Navara26/26. Original error hook did not preserve its resource path; exact cause is unestablished. The first diagnostic repeat was formally green but recorded a lateAIS503 after its early console check; that verdict is invalidated and archived too. All final W1 results below follow final console checks and scoped INFO actions. No HTTP500/503 exception or app/build change.
